homonyms.basis: The census keeps three objects apart under the name (TLL-17, TLL-24, TLL-25): the collection, the tool and the reporting. At the query 'Books3' T composes the collection, a proximal substitute (CAP-1-15); the collection stays a distinct entity in the disambiguation, never a sense of the tool's name. Card 1 names a page 'AI Watchdog: Books3'; whether that page is the census's tool is an open question.
